## Type of change

- [ ] `fix`: bug fix
- [ ] `feat`: new feature
- [ ] `docs`: documentation only
- [ ] `refactor`: code change with no behaviour change
- [ ] `chore`: build, CI, or config

## Testing

- [ ] `python3 -m py_compile server.py` passes
- [ ] CI checks pass
- [ ] Tried it locally with `python3 server.py` and a browser

## Checklist

- [ ] Branch is up to date with `main`
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits (see `CONTRIBUTING.md`)
- [ ] Python 3.6 compatible (no `dict | dict`, walrus, `match`, `removeprefix`)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `## Unreleased` (for user-visible changes)
- [ ] `VERSION` and `__version__` both updated (releases only)
- [ ] No secrets, real config files or data included
